name: ClaimClock small real-answer corpus v1

selection.source: Public Stack Exchange API (api.stackexchange.com 2.3, site=stackoverflow), /search/excerpts, answers created 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, sort=votes, pagesize=40
selection.pipeline: 153 distinct answers returned; a fixed regex kept answers with a sentence that names a product with a version number and a time-sensitive word (latest, current, still, now, end of life, supported until, …): 25 answers. Each was read; 6 were excluded for the reasons listed, 19 were labeled.
selection.notASample: This is a keyword-selected convenience set, deliberately enriched for version and support-status wording. The stale share below describes these 19 answers only; it is not an estimate for Stack Overflow or for answers in general.

labeling.by: Assigned during development with an AI coding assistant by comparing the quoted sentence with the primary source excerpt stored in each row; there was no second, independent human annotator.
labeling.rule: stale-status: a stated current/latest/supported status or date is no longer true on the label date. stale-relative-time: the underlying dates were right, but a relative phrase ("about a month from now", "almost 3 years ago") is now wrong. still-valid: everything quoted still holds.

license: Quoted sentences are short excerpts of Stack Overflow answers (CC BY-SA 4.0), attributed by URL. Answer text is the current revision; lastEditedOn shows when it last changed.

primary.title: What's New In Python 3.12
primary.excerpt: PEP 632 : Remove the distutils package. See the migration guide for advice replacing the APIs it provided. The third-party Setuptools package continues to provide distutils , if you still require it in Python 3.12 and beyond.
